skills.name: Subtract pure fractions
skills.definition: The ability to subtract two fractions that are not mixed numbers, when they have a common denominator. This includes subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers
skills.definition: The ability to subtract two numbers that are mixed numbers (including whole numbers treated as mixed numbers with zero fraction). This involves separating whole and fractional parts, subtracting whole numbers, subtracting fractions (with borrowing if needed), combining the result, and simplifying the fraction if necessary.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: The ability to find a common denominator (e.g., least common denominator) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts of mixed numbers or integers.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is smaller than that of the subtrahend, borrow 1 from the whole part and add the denominator to the numerator.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor, or convert a fraction equal to an integer.

skills.name: Simplify mixed number with improper fraction
skills.definition: Convert an improper fraction part of a mixed number into a whole number and proper fraction, adding to the existing whole part.

skills.name: Rewrite whole number as mixed number
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator by adding a zero fraction.

skills.name: Combine into mixed number or integer
skills.definition: Write the final answer as a mixed number (whole part and fraction) or as an integer if the fraction part is zero.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract one whole number from another, including zero.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Convert fractions to a common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator (typically the least common multiple) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing the numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Simplify mixed numbers with improper fractions
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is an improper fraction into a proper mixed number by adding the whole part to the fractional part.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed number subtraction
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the subtrahend is larger than the fraction part of the minuend, convert one whole from the minuend's whole part into a fraction with the same denominator, add it to the minuend's fraction part, then subtract the fractions.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Convert fractions to a common denominator by finding the least common denominator and rewriting each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with same denominator
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that have the same denominator by subtracting the numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract whole numbers (integer subtraction).

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: Borrow from the whole number part when the fraction subtraction is negative, by decreasing the whole part by 1 and adding the denominator to the numerator of the fraction part, then re-evaluate the subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Simplify a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Combine whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Combine the whole number part and the fraction part to form a mixed number (or integer if the fraction part is zero).

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator of two fractions and rewrite both as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of two numbers.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction yields a negative result, decrease the whole part by 1 and increase the fraction numerator by the denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Normalize mixed number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fraction part (numerator >= denominator) into a proper mixed number by carrying the excess to the whole part.
